guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest latency shift (latency-90 +33598%, z=+6720) and is the common callee of recommendationservice and checkoutservice. Its memory rose about 11x (1.03e7 to 1.17e8, z=+207) alongside CPU +433%, sockets +123%, and the only service-level error series, while the slow traces end in productcatalogservice. Memory is the most extreme resource signal, but CPU and socket changes are also present, so mem versus cpu is not fully separable.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the productcatalogservice pods to clear the memory growth, raise the memory limit temporarily, and then profile for a leak or unbounded cache. Do not delete data.
